headline: Binance Processes $6 Billion in Outflows After Resuming Withdrawals
summary: Binance recorded $6 billion in net outflows after reopening customer withdrawals following a 45-hour freeze. The withdrawals followed a $6.3 billion theft and represented less than 4% of total holdings.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by volume, making its liquidity and operational resilience critical for digital asset market stability.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Large customer withdrawals reduce exchange reserves and liquidity following a security breach.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A temporary freeze and substantial post-resumption capital outflows after a major theft disrupted exchange liquidity and weighed on crypto market confidence.
